mapper.select: /* imageboard-mapper.xml id="selectImageBoardView" 이미지 게시판 단건 조회 */ SELECT seq , mb_id , title , writer_nm , image_url , thumb_url , DATE_FORMAT(in_dtm, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS in_dtm , DATE_FORMAT(up_dtm, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS up_dtm FROM tbts_image_board WHERE mb_id = #{mb_id} AND seq = #{seq} AND use_yn = 'Y'
